name: Bracketraces.com
notes: Individual event pages contain actual flyer images (.webp). No central listing — known event page paths listed below.

name: RacingJunk Events
notes: Text-only event listings, numbered pagination (~20/page). Filter by drag racing type. No flyer images — yields structured text data directly.

name: MyRacePass
notes: REST API available at api.myracepass.com/v2/ but requires API key. HTML pages are publicly crawlable. Text data only, no flyers.

name: TMCCC
notes: GoDaddy site builder calendar. Events use data-aid attributes for reliable scraping. Static fetch only captures initially visible events — JS-loaded 'More Events' are not retrieved.

name: Dragzine RSS
notes: WordPress RSS feed. Covers event news and race coverage, not upcoming event calendars. Useful for discovering events after the fact.
